geometry.scope: Independent indexed triangle-corner UV equality and triangle/material counts. Raw index/UV vertex buffers can be reindexed when the exporter deduplicates attribute vertices; their equality is reported separately. Blender source topology is checked by the preserved source receipt.

blenderSourceEvidence.scope: Read-only Blender receipt. Source export script asserts exact before/after mesh UV, loop vertex indices, polygon/vertex/loop counts, material slots and untouched vertices. This comparison did not execute Blender.
